fact: The IMF states that the e-tax platform for online declaration and payment of corporate taxes has been launched, deployment of the IFMIS (SIGFiP) continues across the provinces, and the payroll database is being cleaned up through biometric identification of civil servants.
title: Chad: 2024 Article IV Consultation-Press Release; Staff Report; and Statement by the Executive Director for Chad (IMF Country Report No. 24/335)
